depiction.primary_object: outlined octagon containing a bold centered exclamation mark
depiction.composition: single octagonal badge, front view, centered

readings.meaning: critical error, fault, or system failure

ambiguity: Closely resembles a circle or triangle with an exclamation mark at small sizes; could also be mistaken for a generic high-priority badge rather than a task subject.

modifier_semantics.meaning: alert, error, warning, danger, or attention required

task_intents: investigate critical system error or crash
respond to security or fraud alert
report safety hazard or workplace incident
clear fault code or warning light
request stop sign or traffic control

example_tasks.task: Investigate why the nightly backup job keeps throwing a permissions error
File the workplace near-miss incident form for the warehouse spill
Petition the council for a stop sign at the Elm Street corner
Write up the root cause analysis before Friday
Silence the noisy disk-space warning on the staging server
Look up the allergen warning on the new peanut butter jar
Walk the basement with the electrician
Figure out why the dishwasher flashes the F24 error halfway through the rinse cycle
Design custom 404 and 500 error pages so users stop seeing raw stack traces
Report the downed power line hazard behind the back fence to the utility company

example_tasks_es: Revisar las alertas de fraude de la tarjeta Visa
Solucionar el error 500 en la pasarela de pagos antes del lanzamiento
Código de fallo F04 en la caldera
example_tasks_ru: Разобраться с ошибкой 403 при входе в личный кабинет
Настроить алерты в Grafana на падение базы данных

context_tasks.task: Buy an OBD2 scanner for the glovebox
Pack flares and reflective triangles in the trunk
Replace the backup battery in the smoke detector
Draft customer email about the service outage

near_misses.task: Urgent: buy birthday gift for Maya before 5pm
Important tax return documents to sign tonight
near_misses.better: document with signature or tax form

near_misses.task: Stop by the dry cleaners on the way home
Check the oven timer in twenty minutes
Renew the domain SSL certificate before it expires
Ask the information desk about the museum audio guide

reasoning: An octagon with an exclamation mark is universally recognized as a stop/danger sign, critical error, or alert. It fits tasks whose actual subject is an error, fault code, security alert, incident, or hazard—though care must be taken not to misuse it for the mere property of 'urgent' on unrelated tasks, and it overlaps visually with circular or triangular warning icons.
